data.name: Bivash
data.gender_notes: Bivash is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bivash is a Sanskrit name derived from the term ‘buddhi’, which means intellect or mind. The name is dedicated to the lord of the mind, symbolizing deep wisdom and understanding. This name is believed to bestow the gift of a sharp intellect and a strong willpower on the bearer. The name Bivash carries the meaning “Lord of the mind, intellect” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bivash usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the mind, intellect and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the attainment of inner peace and calmness, and the ability to create beauty in one's thoughts and actions.
data.etymology: Bivash belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the mind, intellect.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bivash total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
